history.summary: Comparison listing surfaced by the condo search, not the evaluation target. 969 sqft 2BR at $1.63M ($1,682 psf) — the largest 2BR of the three sisters but also the oldest project (TOP 2011) with the shortest remaining lease (~81 years), 400m to Bedok Reservoir MRT.
history.rating_rationale: Mid-pack value: psf sits between Waterfront Gold and the Key target, and the larger 969 sqft floor plate suits families/own-stay, but the higher $1.63M quantum thins the buyer pool and the oldest building plus shortest lease of the trio work against a 5-7 year investment exit. URA cache appreciation 7.34%/yr is backward-looking like its sisters. Not researched in depth — Neutral with low confidence.
red_flags: Oldest of the three sisters (15 years) — renovation and maintenance risk highest here
Shortest remaining lease (~81 years) of the trio
Higher quantum for the same location reduces exit liquidity vs the cheaper sisters
catalysts: Same Bayshore/TEL halo and Bedok Reservoir micro-market scarcity as Waterfront Key

history.summary: D16 waterfront 3BR (1,248sqft) at $2.1M / $1,683psf — essentially at the URA median ($1,691). Strong 7.49%/yr appreciation on a healthy 75-txn base and Bedok Reservoir/park frontage, near DT30 (420m). A fairly-priced, decent hold; reaffirms the prior Neutral leaning toward the upper end.
history.rating_rationale: Priced right at median ($1,683 vs $1,691) — no overpay. 7.49%/yr CAGR is the strongest reliable rate in this batch and the 75-txn base is solid. 420m to Bedok Reservoir DTL and reservoir/park views are genuine lifestyle/rental draws; 405 units gives reasonable liquidity. Offsetting: D16 OCR fundamentals are moderate, reviews flag 'lousy/rude security & management', and the unit's value rests on appreciation already being priced in (no discount to median). Good but not exceptional — consistent with the prior Neutral. A clear Buy would need a below-median entry.

history.summary: The sister block to Waterfront Isle: priced ~7% below the URA median ($1565 vs $1691), 7.49% CAGR, 420m to Bedok Reservoir DTL MRT, with reservoir/park frontage. Slightly older (2011) with thinner data (75 txns) and management/PIE-noise complaints, but the D16 location and sub-median entry support upgrading the prior Neutral to a Buy.
history.rating_rationale: Sub-median entry (~7% below recent URA PSF), a strong 7.49% resale CAGR, and 420m to DT30 Bedok Reservoir MRT put this in the same favourable D16 setup as Waterfront Isle, at a lower quantum. Reservoir-and-park frontage plus the Bayshore precinct/TEL catalysts underpin demand. The prior Neutral looks conservative at the current price. Held to plain Buy rather than higher by a thinner 75-transaction sample, an older 2011 vintage, reported security/management friction, and PIE-exit traffic noise that is stack-dependent.
